correctness.rationale: For a minimal dominating S in connected d-regular G of N vertices, partition selected vertices into isolated I and nonisolated F; each f in F needs a unique outside private neighbor p(f). With Q private neighbors and R the rest, all d|I| incident edges enter R, giving |I|<=|R| and 2|S|<=N. At equality, d-regularity and connectedness force either F empty, giving an independent bipartition side, or I empty, yielding a perfect matching cut between S and its complement. In the labelled prism any independent side of size n must alternate one vertex per rung (two patterns only when n even). A perfect-matching cut either contains a bichromatic rung, forcing all rungs to have the same orientation (top/bottom layers), or all monochromatic rungs and a binary cyclic color word with runs exactly length two, forcing 0011 repeats (four phases if 4|n). Hence Gamma=n and U_n=2+2*1_{2|n}+4*1_{4|n} for every n>=3. Direct independent exhaustive tests of all n-subsets for n3..9 reproduced the full families and counts [2,8,2,4,2,8,2].
residual_risks: The proof does not enumerate smaller inclusion-minimal sets or open ladders.

value.rationale: The upper domination number Γ and the number U_n of maximum-cardinality minimal dominating sets are natural graph invariants; the exact 2/4/8 periodicity gives a complete structural classification for a canonical all-n prism family, including odd nonbipartite instances. The result is distinct from minimum dominating set counts and develops a useful perfect-matching-cut equality structure.
residual_risks: The general half-order bound and perfect-matching-cut framework are classical; novelty is the precise prism family census.

final_claim: For each simple circular prism P_n, n>=3, the upper domination number is n, and exactly U_n=2+2[2|n]+4[4|n] labelled maximum-size minimal dominating sets occur: two layer sets, two alternating independent sides when n even, four paired-rung sets when 4|n.
limitations: Full Southey–Henning 2013 text inaccessible; authorized retrieval reported vpn_disconnected.
